messages:
maya: quick sync — trying to lock a short design review for the new API surface + SDK ergonomics + console UX tweaks. can folks do a lightweight pre-read + optional 45m sync?

maya: goal: surface major tradeoffs (schema changes, auth, rollout plan) and capture followups. prefer to keep this focused — 3 owners walk through, rest can sign off async.

sam: +1. i can present the API schema portion. can we get a short pre-read doc?

maya: added pre-read here: https://internal.redwood/docs/designs/api-sdk-console-preflight — pls skim. TL;DR included below.

kevin: tagging in for rollout / infra concerns @kevin. i might need a heads-up on dedicated vs hosted implications.

li: prefer async-first: put questions in the thread within 48h after pre-read, and we only meet if unresolved items remain. call it a "quiet queue".

jordan: that works for me. proposed slot windows (PST): Wed 10:00-10:45, Thu 14:00-14:45, Fri 9:00-9:45. please react with :one: :two: :three: or suggest other times.

maya: proposing agenda (short):
```
Agenda (45m):
1) 5m quick context + goals (maya)
2) 15m API schema + auth changes (sam)
3) 10m SDK surface & ergonomics (maya)
4) 10m Console UX walkthrough (jordan)
5) 5m rollouts, canary, fallback checklist (kevin)
```

maya: pre-read checklist (please complete before reacting to a slot):
- read design doc + open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/256
- run example locally (quick start snippet in doc)
- add any major blocking issues to this thread (label: pre-read-blocker)
- add quick thumbs or :eyes: to indicate you're good to be async

sam: small ask — can we add a quantified perf goal to the doc? e.g., p50 <= 100ms on dedicated config. i'll add a line in PR.

kevin: I'll outline rollback/fallback options in a short doc and link it here by EOD.

li: putting a note — if you want to be "async only", drop a :eyes: and add a 1-line signoff (ok async) otherwise please be prepared for the call.

jordan: voted :one: and :two: (both work). prefer Wed if people are OK.

maya: cool. if we get 60% :eyes: + no blockers in 48h we'll skip the live session and mark as async approved. otherwise we meet Wed 10.

sam: acked — i'll update PR with perf target and a short code snippet for the SDK change.

kevin: adding fallback checklist here: https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/rollbacks-api-sdk — quick skim pls.

maya: final ask — reviewers: @sam, @kevin, @li, @jordan. if you're on PTO or want to delegate, pls ping the delegate here.

deploy-bot: calendar event created: "API+SDK+Console preflight review" Wed 10:00-10:45 PST if needed — link added to thread.

maya: thanks all — i'll follow up in 48h with poll result and next steps. :thumbsup:
